predecessors.name: Caliphate of Córdoba
predecessors.text: the province of Dénia, which the saqaliba under Mujahid took as the Caliphate declined

successors.name: Crown of Aragon
successors.text: Abu Zayd 'Abd ar-Rahman's last taifa, 'in Alzira, Xàtiva also' (with Dénia)

ledger.x: 1010: Mujahid al-'Amiri founds the taifa of Dénia.
1015: Mujahid's fleet takes the Balearic Islands.
1015: a Dénia army lands in Sardinia.
1015: a Dénia army lands in Sardinia.
1016: the Sardinian camp is gone after 'one year'; Pisan and Genoese fleets reconquered Sardinia (no date given) and Mujahid's heir Ali Iqbal was captured and 'could be ransomed only in 1032'.
1016: the Sardinian camp is gone after 'one year'; Pisan and Genoese fleets reconquered Sardinia (no date given) and Mujahid's heir Ali Iqbal was captured and 'could be ransomed only in 1032'.
1021: Mujahid's hold on Valencia ends (rulers list 1017-1021); the Valencia page's ruler table has the same separate 1017-1021 entry for him.
1050: 'In 1050 the Balearic governor, Abd Allah ibn Aglab, gained autonomy for the islands.'
1076: the Balearic Islands leave Dénia for good.
1076: the Balearic Islands become the independent taifa of Majorca (see the vassal_end).
1224: Abu Zayd 'Abd ar-Rahman rules a last Dénia taifa (rulers list 'Abu Zayd 'Abd ar-Rahman (in Alzira, Xàtiva also): 1224–1227').
1227: Aragon conquers the last of Dénia.

wars.name: Mujahid's Balearic and Sardinian expedition
wars.outcome: Dénia took the Balearic Islands in 1015, camped in northern Sardinia for one year and was driven out by Pisan and Genoese fleets; Mujahid's heir Ali Iqbal was captured and ransomed only in 1032.

wars.name: Dénia and Valencia, peace of 1041
wars.outcome: Through Sulayman ibn Hud of Zaragoza, Dénia 'signed a treaty of peace with Valencia in 1041'; no frontier change is recorded.

wars.name: Zaragoza's conquest of Dénia
wars.outcome: Ahmad al-Muqtadir of Zaragoza captured Dénia in 1076; the islands became the independent taifa of Majorca.

wars.name: Aragonese conquest of the last Dénia taifa
wars.outcome: The 'remnants' of the taifa, under Abu Zayd (in Alzira, Xàtiva also), were conquered by Aragon in 1227.

certainty.note: No treaty line on any page opened for the taifa itself; the Biar-Busot-Villajoyosa line of the 1244 Treaty of Almizra is later than the state.
